enrichment.name: Brigade Stellaris
enrichment.config_mix: 3 BHK / 3.5 BHK / 4 BHK, plus larger 4+ BHK duplex units
enrichment.density_note: mid-density luxury high-rise: ~284-300 units in 4 towers (2 basement + stilt + 13-14 floors) on ~5.2-5.4 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA number TNRERA/29/BLG/0052/2026 confirmed on the listing page, so identity is certain. Top-end Velachery address next to Phoenix Marketcity with 21 amenities (pool, fitness studio, squash and badminton courts, spa, business centre, 3-tier security); rate quoted at Rs 22,450/sqft. Sources differ on the upper band: RoofandFloor caps the project at Rs 7.68 Cr for 3,500 sqft 4 BHKs while NoBroker lists 4+ BHK duplexes (3,773-3,992 sqft carpet) up to Rs 16.96 Cr, so the duplex tier sits well above the ticket_max reported here. Unit counts vary 284 (RoofandFloor) vs 300 (NoBroker) and land 5.41 vs 5.19 acres.

enrichment.name: Sri Ramachandra
enrichment.density_note: ultra-boutique: only 9 units on 0.18 acre, stilt + 4/5 floors
enrichment.notes: LOCALITY DISCREPANCY: both portals place this Ceebros 'Sri Ramachandra' at 10th Avenue, Ashok Nagar 600083, not Kodambakkam - the two are adjacent Central Chennai neighbourhoods in the same TNRERA zone 29, and Ceebros lists only one project by this name, so it is almost certainly the same record. Neither source printed the RERA number, so the match to TNRERA/29/BLG/0141/2026 is by name+developer+zone. Single-config 4 BHK boutique block of 9 flats, Vaastu compliant, 100% power backup, covered car parking; ChennaiProperties quotes Rs 18,000/sqft base (Rs 4.59 Cr + charges, possession Mar 2027) while JLL quotes Rs 5.70 Cr onwards (~Rs 22,300/sqft, possession Sep 2026) - the gap is likely base-price vs all-inclusive.

enrichment.name: Rhythm By Dac (Villas)
enrichment.config_mix: 2 BHK / 3 BHK apartments, 867-1364 sqft (portal data; RERA title says 'Villas')
enrichment.notes: TWO DISCREPANCIES - treat with care. (1) Every public source places 'Rhythm By DAC' at Shantha Nagar/Sathasiva Nagar, MADAMBAKKAM, not Adambakkam; Madambakkam falls in TNRERA zone 35 (matching TNRERA/35/BLG/0237/2026) whereas Adambakkam would be zone 29, so the tracker's locality is very likely a transcription error. (2) The RERA title carries '(Villas)' but the marketed product is 2/3 BHK apartments at 867-1364 sqft on 1.52 acres - a villa read is inconsistent with 165 units on that footprint. DAC's own site confirms 'Rhythm By DAC, Madambakkam, Ongoing' but publishes no specs. Price 'Rs 60 lakh onwards', possession Feb 2028, still pre-launch so no per-sqft rate published. Sister project DAC Vilva (same locality, 3-4 BHK villas 2,413-2,517 sqft) trades around Rs 8,300-9,850/sqft if a villa comparison is needed.

enrichment.name: Eterna
enrichment.density_note: large plotted township: ~500 plots on 20 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA number TNRERA/1/LO/3907/2025 printed on G Square's own microsite - identity confirmed. Located at Mevalurkuppam, ~1.5 km from Thandalam Junction and 2.6 km from Saveetha Medical College on the Sriperumbudur/Bangalore Highway belt. Flat Rs 1,790/sqft across the layout (10.74L for 600 sqft, 44.9L for 2,511 sqft - both derive to the same rate). Infrastructure-ready gated plots: blacktop internal roads, streetlights, 24x7 CCTV, multi-purpose play court, gazebo, kids' play equipment, one year free maintenance, plus G Square Built Assist for villa construction. FindBHK marks it 'ready to move' (i.e. registrable plots), so stage_observed is inferred from that.

enrichment.name: Jains Ashwit Nagar
enrichment.notes: RERA number TNRERA/35/LO/0679/2026 printed on Jain Housing's own project page - identity confirmed. Location is Mappedu on the Tambaram Eastern Bypass (Chengalpattu district, zone 35), which is the GST Road / Tambaram belt rather than GST Road proper. Developer states 'Rs 65 Lakhs onwards' for 1,000-2,500 sqft plots and 53 units; status listed as 'Upcoming', no possession date published. The Rs 6,500/sqft figure is arithmetic from Rs 65L on the smallest 1,000 sqft plot - if the entry price actually applies to a mid-size plot the true rate is lower, and no portal carries a published per-sqft rate to cross-check. Amenities: yoga/meditation area, solar street lights, party lawn, blacktop roads, storm water drains, walking track, reflexology pathway, kids' play area. Note the entry ticket is high relative to peer Mappedu layouts, which is worth a second look before publishing.

enrichment.name: Temple Town 2.0
enrichment.notes: NO PRICING PUBLISHED for the 2.0 / Phase-2 registration (TNRERA/1/LO/3115/2026). Lancor's own Temple Town page, the standalone lancortempletown.com microsite and every portal listing still carry only the ORIGINAL Temple Town under RERA TN/01/Layout/2534/2023 (13.36 acres, 292 plots, 600-2,617 sqft, from ~Rs 12.5 lakh, DTCP 143/2021) - a different registration, so I did not copy those numbers across. Corroborating context only: trade press confirms Temple Town Phases 1 and 2 are components of Lancor's 90-acre 'Town & Country' integrated township at Ramapuram Village, Sriperumbudur (~2,000 units, Rs 2,100-2,300 Cr projected revenue, 6-7 year build-out), and Lancor's own market note puts Sriperumbudur plot rates at Rs 1,900-2,800/sqft as of mid-2025. Re-check after the phase is formally marketed.

enrichment.name: Shriram Santrupthi - Phase 2
enrichment.notes: NO PRICING OR CONFIG PUBLISHED for the Phase-2 registration (TNRERA/1/BLG/0167/2026). Shriram Properties' own Chennai page lists Shriram Santrupthi under SOLD OUT with no phase breakdown, and SquareYards' 28-project Chennai index shows no Santrupthi Phase 2 and no new 2026 Valarpuram/Sriperumbudur launch. The existing Santrupthi at Valarpuram (part of the 40-acre Shriram OneCity township, RERA TN/01/Building/0191/2018 and TN/01/Building/0408/2020) is 87 ready-to-move 2/3 BHK villas of 1,205-1,551 sqft at roughly Rs 32-54 lakh (~Rs 2,700-3,500/sqft) - deliberately NOT carried into the price fields since Phase 2 is registered as BLG (apartments) under a separate 2026 number and is a different product. Nearby Shriram Subham (Valarpuram, 2 BHK apartments) may be the marketing name this registration eventually surfaces under, but that is unconfirmed.

enrichment.name: Tvs Emerald Green Hills Phase V
enrichment.notes: NO DATA FOUND for Phase V (TNRERA/35/LO/1973/2026). TVS Emerald's own Green Hills page covers only Phases 1 and 2 (Nedungundram/New Perungalathur, 18 acres, 448 units in 12 towers, launched 2013, occupied, RERA listed as NA) and its plots index does not mention a Green Hills plotted phase at all. Portals go no further than Green Hills Villa Phase IV (Perungalathur, 1,486-2,912 sqft villas, Rs 52.01 lakh - Rs 1.02 Cr as of Jun 2026). Since Phase V is an LO (layout/plotted) registration and every published figure belongs to earlier building/villa phases at a different address, I carried nothing across. The Green Hills estate sits at Nedungundram near Vandalur-Perungalathur on the GST Road belt, which is consistent with the tracker's locality.

enrichment.name: Vgn Viruksham
enrichment.config_mix: villa plots 582-1965 sqft (381 plots + 3 shop units)
enrichment.density_note: large gated plotted layout: 381 numbered plots plus 3 shops across A, B and C blocks on 15.66 acres
enrichment.notes: RERA number TNRERA/35/LO/0930/2026 printed verbatim on the project microsite (also DTCP 94/2025) - identity confirmed despite the naming difference. DEVELOPER DISCREPANCY: the project is marketed as 'VIP Viruksham' / 'Virukshyam' by VIP Housing and Properties, though one of its own pages credits 'VGN and VIP Housing and Properties', so treat it as a VIP Housing layout (possibly a VGN-VIP tie-up) rather than a pure VGN Homes product. LOCATION: Singaperumal Koil, Chengalpattu district, directly opposite Mahindra World City off GST Road - consistent with the tracker's GST Road belt tag. Entry price Rs 10 lakh; the Rs 1,718/sqft figure is arithmetic from that on the smallest 582 sqft plot and no site publishes a headline per-sqft rate, so the upper ticket is left null. Layout is complete and registrable (blacktop roads, 24x7 security, solar street lights, landscaping, 3-phase EB line, 40 ft roads, good ground water, 80% bank funding tie-ups). Strong industrial-demand catchment: Mahindra World City SEZ across the road.
